script.cover_1: The little green dot beside your name. Who is watching it?
script.payoff: Some tools show status to everyone, and fair use checks the work, not the minutes.
script.caption: A green dot shows presence and tells nothing about the work. Send this to the one who keeps the chat open all day.
script.situation: Can your manager track when your chat shows you online?
script.answer: Some tools show it to everyone, so it may be visible. Fair use is checking work, not minutes.
script.reply_me: Shall I send my day's plan each morning? Then you can see the work, not just the status dot.
